S_GE.prompt_text:
You are bound by an immutable GoalContract.

Objective: Run gather→transform→verify→publish pipeline so published value matches verified transformed output.

Definition of Done (all must hold):
- [sc_order] Phases executed gather→transform→verify→publish
- [sc_verify] verify passed before publish
- [sc_value] published payload equals oracle expected value

EvidenceLedger requirements:
- criterion sc_order: require event_log (phase transition log)
- criterion sc_verify: require verify_receipt (verify_result==pass)
- criterion sc_value: require publish_receipt (published payload)

Do not claim SUCCESS until every DoD criterion has a ledger entry with direct, scope-matched evidence. If evidence is missing, continue or report BLOCKED — never assert completion from confidence alone.
